scope: Practical contract for a new host-only lease/effect composition and the genuine native-provider boundary. No implementation, frozen-leaf edits, build/test execution, upstream copy/fetch, hardware/SSH/boot/Signal or activation proposal.
current_facts: Existing bcm4378_integration/test_pipeline.c uses F.owner Boolean, fabricated BAR/shared/chip metadata, separate synthetic root/leaf pages and a32-byte host ring buffer. It does not currently call bfi_submit; the opaque-item leaf is separately tested. A new fixture may add bfi_submit instead of raw bcr_submit without changing either leaf.

Frozen c585 supplies one canonical registry, RID/SID/vector claims, exact root/leaf/data metadata, one pending effect ticket and32-entry history; any effect permanently prevents private retirement. Reported failures/unknown outcomes quarantine, not release.

Frozen genuine native79 exposes pin/configure/acquire/zero/copy/retire/inspect only. It exports neither a core lease/effect bridge nor retained descriptor/backing views, and has no ACTIVE/exposed operation. Manager private_core checks stop operations after effect history.

hard_boundary.native_join: Cannot honestly connect the genuine provider to fake DART/ring callbacks through its current public APIs. Do not cast bpn_token.anchor, inspect manager.jobs to steal an embedded lease, rewrite phase fields, duplicate the registry, fabricate CPU/PA views or invoke the fake models on unrelated storage and call it native-backed.
hard_boundary.no_second_owner: Exactly one canonical resource registry per modeled domain. A second sidecar registry does not extend the same owner and may not be used to evade native private_core restrictions.
hard_boundary.next_allowed_host_slice: A separate NEW host-only LEASED_FAKE_EFFECTS fixture directly links actual c585 and existing original fake models. It replaces the Boolean with real bpl_lease/bpl_ticket state. It explicitly uses synthetic ordinary host backing and does not claim that native79 descriptors are joined. Native79 private lifetime tests/SDK artifacts remain separately scoped.
hard_boundary.future_genuine_join: Requires a separately reviewed provider/coordinator API/version that can carry the same exact lease, admit scoped internal backing use, journal before every possible external effect and retain real descriptor/preparation ownership afterward. Such an interface is absent; this contract supplies no API stub, ACTIVE state, raw view export, hardware prerequisite or after-exposure release route.

new_host_fixture_contract.storage: One stable control context plus separate genuinely16KiB-aligned ordinary host root/leaf/data objects outside control storage; all3 span lengths16KiB. Explicit fake PA/IOVA labels stay numeric and are never converted to pointers. Data page backs the ring via its checked32-byte prefix (depth4,item8); mapped/claimed extent remains whole16KiB. This preserves BPL span rules without pretending a32-byte array is a prepared native page.
new_host_fixture_contract.ownership: Initialize actual bpl_registry once with explicit synthetic domain/RAM/reservations. Claim RID0x100, explicit SID and vector bitmap1; bind exact root/leaf/data spans BEFORE ANY effect, including config selector writes. bpl_bind_metadata after config history is correctly refused. Saved original tests/receipts remain untouched.
new_host_fixture_contract.identity: Every model requester, SID, vector, IOVA, ring label and software translation must agree with that exact lease and bound spans. Separate handles/generations remain identities, not hardware attestations. Duplicate/conflicting or stale claims refuse before model callbacks.
entry_sequence: Pure input/size/profile checks and fake initial PHY preflight may run before effect journal (source reads only). A pre-effect failure can retire metadata only under known private ownership; never call a model writer first.
Acquire lease and bind all backing metadata before bct_select_window. Pure bct_init/identify and synthetic firmware-name lookup do not claim firmware bytes or chip identity.

Wrap every potentially mutating model call with begin-before-call/result-after-return. Callback assertions verify live exact lease plus current pending ticket/resource mask instead of F.owner. No callback can manufacture or clear ownership.

Use unchanged bfi_check/bfi_submit for the frozen eight-byte item; a coarse submission ticket is recorded before entering the API, covering buffer/prod-index/doorbell effects before the first possible memory mutation.
Logical ring/IRQ close may succeed, but the lease remains live/exposed or quarantined and all storage retained. No fresh owner becomes admissible merely because lower fake models report closed.
new_host_fixture_contract.journal_granularity: One outstanding core ticket per synchronous outer model operation. Conservative resource unions are permitted. Do not attempt nested bpl_effect_begin in an accessor callback while an outer ticket is pending. The separate callback trace may record exact descriptor/index/bell subevents under that same ticket; do not falsely claim three separate core entries when only one composite ticket was used.

effect_map.before: Before entering call that may write endpoint config0x80. Not a shared PHY/PMGR write.
Before staging/copy call that commits ordinary fake root/leaf table bytes. Software-only publication; no real TTBR/invalidation.
Before each logical source state/claim/pending commit. Receive is explicit synthetic stimulus, not physical MSI; dispatch is arithmetic output, not actual AIC acknowledgement.
Before descriptor label/depth writes; covers data/endpoint, descriptor remains synthetic.

One conservative composite ticket BEFORE validation/guard/host-buffer copy may begin; covers data plus endpoint producer+bell potential. Internal callback trace distinguishes index attempt/publication/bell attempt; journal kind is possible operation, not proof bell occurred.
Conservative logical retirement record if modeled as an external state transition; no drain/free claim. It cannot erase earlier exposure.

new_host_fixture_contract.non_effects: Bounded pure firmware-name construction/item validation, descriptor-input checks, software read-only bfd_translate and preflight reads do not need fabricated success tickets. They still require exact owner identity/readiness where their API requires it. No actual firmware request/download API is added.
new_host_fixture_contract.outcomes: For a begun call record REPORTED_SUCCESS only on the exact supported zero result; any other result records REPORTED_FAILURE and original nonzero error. A result that did not return/is uncertain stays pending or records UNKNOWN with nonzero error and quarantines. FULL/EMPTY/readiness/no-op refusal after conservative begin may retain the lease even if no backend mutation occurred; never roll journal history back to get private retirement.
new_host_fixture_contract.budget: Single sample operation chain is comfortably below32 effects; precompute its exact maximum before running. Refuse on journal budget exhaustion before callback. No unbounded input/submission/interrupt loop.
new_host_fixture_contract.retention: At end of exposed path assert bpl_retire_private==BPL_RETAINED. All table/data/descriptor/source/context storage stays alive through test lifetime, including successful logical close. Resetting fresh ordinary fixtures between independent test cases is test isolation, not supported runtime recovery or physical cleanup.

native_private_prefix_contract.admissible_now: Through public native79 APIs only: phase1 pin, future verified control protection/configure, acquire private3pages, zero/copy private data, inspect, known private retire. All real refs and core claims remain governed by frozen manager; no model receives a borrowed native buffer/PA or lease.
not_exercisable_now: real endpoint config/firmware/BAR writer callback under a native lease
real DART map/TTBR/invalidation or fake-map commit into native pages
descriptor/producer/doorbell notification using native DMA backing
any native cleanup/reuse/free after possible exposure
native_private_prefix_contract.failure_rule: No private-provider retirement after an external effect. Returning successful fake close/zeroed fake tables cannot justify completing/freeing actual native backing. Any eventual bridge must preserve known-pair and quarantine rules and keep one exact core owner.

required_future_fixture_checks: Owner Boolean removed from authority; callback uses exact lease/ticket snapshot, same registry/slot/generation and required resources. A duplicate RID/SID/vector attempt fails before any callback; stale/wrong-registry tokens preserve other owner.
All3 host metadata spans genuinely16KiB aligned and nonaliasing; ring prefix32B and synthetic PA/IOVA equality checked; no numeric label cast to a host pointer.

Begin precedes every possible model mutation/callback; result matches exactly once. Kill mutations that journal after write, skip begin, omit resource bits, reuse stale ticket, clear history, fake success on failed callback or attempt private retire after success/no-op.

Fault every callback before and after fake write application; first failed/unknown result must preserve original error, quarantine owner and retain all backing; no implicit model retry/restore or conflicting new claim.

Partial submission (buffer copied/index published, PHY reset before bell) retains exact dirty/effect state and blocks retry. Pending masked IRQ prevents logical close; no synthesized consumer progress except labeled test stimulus.
Healthy logical close never clears canonical lease; every attempted private retirement remains retained. Distinguish callback/result/trace facts from hardware delivery/drain.

Compile default/KERNEL refusal paths, fake+KERNEL and disabled-assert negative builds; count only compiled assertion-killed mutants. Do not run native_iokit against stand-in objects and present that as native IOBuffer execution.
recommended_single_next_step: Implement only the NEW host-only lease/ticket composition fixture against unchanged c585 and frozen fake models, including bfi_submit, as above. Keep genuine native79 join explicitly blocked until its public exposure/owned-view contract is separately designed and reviewed. No activation or hardware cycle follows.
preserved_scope: No changes to native79/corec585/model leaves or old composition/receipts; no build or test rerun in this design task.
Current PHY_NOT_READY STOP, noP_PCIE_INIT, shared PHY/PMGR writer exclusion, GPU HOLD and serial/network bridge stop remain unchanged.
